narrative.overview: HackOps treats a hackathon season like a football season. Every deadline is a fixture with a kick-off time in Malaysia time; whatever the team is building runs a live match clock; every result goes into a form guide. The shell wears Harimau Malaya colours, an ink-black rail and tiger gold, so the identity lives in the frame while the work area stays a calm, neutral ground for dense lists and boards.
keyCharacteristics: Ink rail and gold active state carry the identity; the work area stays neutral.
Time is set in condensed tabular numerals, always in MYT.
Signal red belongs only to the live clock and anything due within 24 hours.
Flat surfaces, hairline borders, no drop shadows.
Icons are Phosphor bold SVG files, never a React icon package.

rules.name: The Reserved Red Rule
rules.body: Signal red marks only the live match clock and deadlines due within 24 hours. If something is red, it is urgent; nothing decorative, no error styling, no brand use.

rules.name: The Frame Not Fill Rule
rules.body: Ink and gold live in the shell (rail, fixtures, primary action, active state). The work area stays neutral so the data reads first.

rules.name: The Condensed For Time Rule
rules.body: Any number a person scans to decide something (a time, a date, a countdown, a count, a score) is set in Barlow Condensed. Sentences are never condensed.

rules.name: The No Shadow Rule
rules.body: Surfaces separate by colour and hairlines, never by box-shadow.

dos: Do set every time in Malaysia time and in condensed tabular numerals.
Do keep ink and gold in the shell and the work area neutral.
Do use Phosphor bold SVGs from public/icons through the Icon component.
Do give every empty page a dashed empty state saying what will appear and where it comes from.
Do keep keyboard paths for anything draggable (board cards, tasks).
donts: Don't use Signal Red for anything except the live clock and deadlines due within 24 hours.
Don't add drop shadows, gradients, glass or blur.
Don't add football costume: pitches, grass, crests, jerseys, stadium photos.
Don't install a React icon library or use emoji or Unicode glyphs as icons.
Don't put a small label or eyebrow above a heading; the heading speaks for itself.
Don't put gold text on the light ground; gold only sits on ink or behind ink text.
